portfolio_controls.acceptance_rule: A return must contain a typed lemma, construction, counterexample, or obstruction with equations, exact assumptions, failure test, open gap, and novelty fingerprint; summaries and confidence statements do not count.
portfolio_controls.independence_limit: The two audits used isolated prompt context but share the Codex runtime, model family, repository, and coordinator. They are mechanism-diverse search inputs, not independent corroborating evidence.
portfolio_controls.duplicate_policy: Retire or redirect a return whose novelty fingerprint repeats without removing a named gap.

mechanism_families.bridge: P_{l+1} overline(Q_l) E_l is the exact nonlinear interaction map, while P_{l+1} overline(U_l^{phi_g}) E_l is its derivative at g; fixed U_l occurs only at the zero interaction.

The extraction norm is at most 3^|V|-1 and this finite-size dependence is worst-case sharp; no dimension-free bound is claimed.

A bounded idempotent retained projection carries exact coordinate and quotient residuals that vanish exactly under exact-image invariance.
Componentwise/permutation gauge realization plus the RN kernel square gives covariance; diagonal cloning and torus shear mark the exact premise boundaries.
open_gaps: Generalized modes, beta functions, and fixed interaction objects remain the separate Task 9 interface; there is no remaining Task 8 construction gap under the per-scale product-equivalence premise.
